Specification: This module defines a utility predicate for reasoning about finite functional graphs represented by a relation or function r over a set S. The main operator, IsSimpleCycle, characterizes when repeatedly following r from a chosen start node visits exactly the elements of S, using a finite sequence built over 1..Cardinality(S). The module is a helper-style specification with no variables, actions, temporal behavior, fairness, or proofs; it relies on imported modules for integers, sequences, finite-set cardinality, and function-domain/range operators.
IfThenElse: IF i = 1 THEN << CHOOSE s \in S : TRUE >> ELSE LET seq == F[i-1] head == Head(seq) IN << r[head] >> \o F[i-1]
FunctionConstructor: [ i \in 1..Cardinality(S) ] == IF i = 1 THEN << CHOOSE s \in S : TRUE >> ELSE LET seq == F[i-1] head == Head(seq) IN << r[head] >> \o F[i-1]
